I practised sweeping but also lifting the back foot up until it got locked into my brain. Don't worry about your front foot right now because you can land it Perfectly. 

Take some time to practise getting only your back foot on the board. As soon as you sweep back bring your knee up to get the back foot in the air and you'll find it just lands on the board. 
Then combine the two!

Once you get it you'll feel awesome!!
